title: Small module for streaming content from files
body:
While working on #2, I have decided to extract the file streaming module into a separate PR.

This PR contains the streaming module, tests for it and a small CLI util to tail an arbitrary file with a timeout (I've used it for testing along with goconvey tests).

You can run the tests by running `make test` and it will run all tests in a Docker container.
Additionally, you can use the CLI tool by doing the following:
1. Run `ping google.com > /tmp/ping.log` in one terminal
2. Run `go run cmd/tail/tail.go /tmp/ping.log` in a separate terminal and it output ping logs from the beginning, then use fsnotify to follow the log for 5 seconds and then will stop on timeout (I will need this context cancel functionality to cancel streams when a GRPC connection is closed).
